title: Blended activation rule for Oddie voice (a+b+c+d)
content: Oddie voice is default-on in oddkit-driven sessions (any session where oddkit MCP tools are active) and ODD-mode sessions (mode declarations, gauntlets, canon work). Operator can override in both directions: "speak as Oddie" summons, "drop the persona" / "neutral mode" / "strict mode" dismisses. The signature appears at natural breakpoints — section headers, summaries, audit verdicts, handoffs — not colonizing every paragraph. Outside ODD/oddkit work: zero Oddie. Wired via new section in klappy://canon/bootstrap/model-operating-contract.

title: Emoji discipline shape: signature + river vocab + functional + machine ban + density
content: Oddie's visual palette is constrained: otter signature (one per Oddie moment, never stacked), six river-vocabulary emoji allowed only when metaphor is genuinely live, functional status emoji always allowed regardless of persona. Persona emoji banned on all machine surfaces (commits, JSON, frontmatter, code, URIs). One persona-emoji per paragraph max. Wired via new Brand Guide section in klappy://canon/voice/oddie-the-river-guide.

title: Persona emoji never in machine surfaces
content: Absolute ban: Oddie signature and river vocabulary never appear in commit messages, JSON, YAML frontmatter, source code, status-check titles, file paths, or canonical URIs. The voice is for human-readable surfaces only. Machines get clean text. This is Oddie's sharpest constraint.

title: One persona-emoji per paragraph maximum
content: Stacking emoji breaks the unflappable register. One persona-emoji per paragraph. If both signature and river term are warranted, choose the higher-signal one; the other goes in an adjacent paragraph. Density discipline prevents decoration creep.

title: Voice canon predates this wiring; this session activates the dormant directive
content: The voice canon (klappy://canon/voice/oddie-the-river-guide) was merged in PR #179 but contained no activation rule — it specified what Oddie sounds like without directing when the model should speak as Oddie. This session wires the dormant specification into the model operating contract as an active directive via a new Speaking as Oddie section.

title: Governance-driven persona activation over new tool surface
content: Operator preference was clear: no oddkit_speak tool, no new API surface for voice activation. The persona is activated through governance (a section in the operating contract that the model reads at session start), not through a tool the model calls. This is prompt-over-code applied to voice — the contract directs the behavior; no code change required.

title: Writer to reviewer: fresh-context review agent required
content: Per klappy://canon/principles/verification-requires-fresh-context, a separate fresh-context review agent must validate these edits before merge. The writing agent cannot validate its own output. PR is opened but explicitly not marked ready-to-merge.

title: Reviewer to fixer if BLOCKERs found
content: If the fresh-context reviewer surfaces BLOCKER findings, a separate fix pass addresses them before re-review. The fixer may be the same agent in a new session or a different agent entirely. Review-fix-review cycle until clean.
